name: Raise3D N2 Plus 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
G90
G21
M82
M107
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; start bed heating
M104 T0 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[0] - 20} ; preheat nozzle
; home all axes
G28
G92 X0 Y0 Z0
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; wait for bed temp
M109 T0 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; wait for nozzle temp
; move heatbed into position
G1 X20.0 Y20.0 Z1.0 F1000
; zero extruder
G92 E0
T0
; set extruder steps per mm
M92 E140
; purge nozzle
G1 E25 F250
; zero extruder
G92 E0
; move heatbed down a little more
G1 Z5.0 F20
; wait 600ms
G4 600
; move to tack down the strands
G1 X20.0 Y30.0 Z0 F9000
; wait 600ms
G4 600
;move up a bit
G1 Z5.0 F9000
; wait 300ms
G4 300
;fast move to center
G1 X152.5 Y152.5 F9000
T0
;Raise3D Job Start
M117 Printing...
M1001
machine_end_gcode:
M107
M1002
M104 S0 T0
M140 S0
M117 Print Complete.
G28 X0 Y0
G91
G1 Z10
G90
M84
